body: Stuck 'typing…' root cause: there is NO expiry anywhere. ChatEngine.handleNativeSocketFrame (:9227) inserts the peer id into peerTypingUserIdsByChatId and only ever removes it on an explicit stop-typing frame, socket open/close/error, or closeChatChannel. Sender side is worse: sendTypingState (:2211) dedupes on nativeTypingStateByChatId[chatId] == typing, so a peer emits exactly ONE 'typing' when the composer becomes non-empty and one 'stop-typing' when it empties. Background the app, kill it, drop the socket, or just leave text sitting in the composer and the stop never arrives — the receiver shows 'typing…' forever. Fix needs both halves: receiver-side per-(chat,user) timestamp + ~6s expiry sweep, and sender-side keepalive refresh every ~4s plus an idle stop-typing after ~5s of no keystrokes.
